cases.name: Alicia Ann Greer
cases.about: Her father spoke about her courage and kindness. He spoke about her adventurous and artistic spirit. He spoke to how she doted on her three children, how she lent her ears and opened her doors to anyone who needed her, how the world is a poorer place for her absence. He said his daughter had a passion for helping people in need, and often sheltered friends in their home when they were going through tough times.
cases.narrative: He later shot and killed himself when he and a female companion Mary Rice were surrounded by police at a Georgia motel.

cases.name: Jacqualine "Jaci" Jeanette Moore
cases.about: “Jaci had a big heart,” her mom said. “There was never a picture taken where she was frowning. She was bubbly and never knew a stranger.” Jaci chose a career as a waitress because she enjoyed meeting people. “She was very spirited and did things her own way.” She loved children and even taught Sunday school. “Most of all, she loved her three children very much,” said Brenda.
